epic.title: the door is the interface (#567), wave 2, lane E
epic.intent_and_why: Capture MCP door refusals into the run's durable episode record instead of letting them vanish, and retire the door's own CLI-recommending refusal text (issue #541, wave 2 lane E).

definition_of_done: A real door-own refusal, triggered through the door in a fresh process, is readable back out of episodes/ via query_episodes.py.
A negative control shows the same refusal leaves no trace with the capture removed.
The two _spine_bind containment-refusal sites (plus a third identical occurrence found in _identity_violation) no longer recommend the CLI to an agent.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Every captured field is a literal derivation from the refusal's own data -- never invented narrative -- honoring docs/EPISODE_STORE.md's refuse-never-fabricate contract.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Fresh-process trigger + negative control, re-derived independently by both the reviewer and the Commander, plus the full test suite green in a clean detached worktree.
good_enough.appetite: One bounded gate inside a single-issue Commander lane.

hard_constraints: sole writer this wave: scripts/mcp_spine_server.py, episodes/**
no-inode-containment stands -- do not close spine_bind's hardlink hole
do not touch scripts/checklist_engine.py (lane H) or docs/** except docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md (lane D1)
fixed_decisions: capture-is-literal-derivation-only: every agent-supplied field is a literal quotation/extraction of real refusal data, never composed narrative

current_wave.objective: Ship the door-refusal episode capture and the inherited refusal-text swap for issue #541.
exit_criteria: Full suite green in a clean detached worktree (MapTreeFreshnessTests excepted)

issues.title: MCP door refusals vanish -- capture them into the run's episode
issues.desired_outcome: A door refusal is durably captured in episodes/, provable from a fresh process, with a negative control.
issues.useful_now: The launch order names two real dispatch-time refusals the Admiral hit this wave that left no trace anywhere a later reader could find.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Fresh-process trigger reads back from episodes/ via query_episodes.py; negative control shows no trace without the capture.
issues.implementation_latitude: Where on the door path to capture, and the record's shape, is the Commander's own to decide (decision:capture-filter-is-yours).
hard_constraints_no_gos: never fabricate a mechanical or agent-supplied field
local_unknowns: whether apply_episode_delta.py / verify_episode_captured.py is satisfiable from inside the server process -- RESOLVED yes
whether a refusal with no bound spine has a work-id to attribute to -- RESOLVED no, capture is skipped for that case
whether capturing every refusal floods the store -- RESOLVED no, filtered to the door-own population plus in-process dedup

discrepancies.evidence: Reproduces identically on the untouched base commit f05a3d78 in a fresh detached worktree with no code changes at all -- CREW_SCRATCH_DIR leaks from this Commander's own ambient dispatched-crew session into the test's os.environ-inheriting subprocess-launch assertion. Disappears once CREW_SCRATCH_DIR is unset alongside the SPINE_* vars the check command already excluded.

Corrected the g1-integrate.c1 check command via the engine's retext-check amend op to unset CREW_SCRATCH_DIR too, rather than touching the test itself (which lane D1/H do not own either, and which is not actually broken outside this ambient condition).

discrepancies.affects: Whether the shipped design (capture-is-literal-derivation-only) is accepted doctrine, or whether docs/EPISODE_STORE.md needs its own follow-up.
discrepancies.evidence: DESIGN_NOTE.md's closing paragraph; the cold critic's finding #3 (surfaced then resolved via literal-quotation sourcing for every field, including expected-behavior sourced from the tool's own registered MCP description); the shipped episode content itself (episodes/active/567-e-002.md, 567-e-004.md), inspectable directly to judge whether any field reads as invented.
